sampling_unit: complete state×age×geometry×D/U configuration; census snapshots nested; no independent populations
preparation: three identical full saved complete phase components including arms; remove one whole clone at t0; no later native intervention
phase: elapsed preparation updates, not homologous reproductive phases

contrasts.age_effect: per state and fixed geometry, signed difference of exact per-condition retention bounds and absolute disturbed count ranges
contrasts.geometry_effect: per state and fixed age, B-A or F-E; complete spatial challenges include sites and removed-clone location, not a pure distance effect or replicated identical geometry treatment
contrasts.interaction: difference of age differences across each declared geometry pair; report intervals and missingness
contrasts.all_cells: retain all4age×4geometry cells for descriptive comparison

benefit.relative: each panel averages eight per-condition retention intervals (4ages×2geometries); candidate lower strictly exceeds both originating input upper bounds in both panels
benefit.absolute: candidate disturbed Q mean strictly exceeds both input disturbed C means in both panels; exact five-snapshot sums; ties fail
benefit.joint: relative and absolute robust superiority plus all calibration, exposure and non-equivalence gates; failed frozen calibration prevents joint confirmation
benefit.overlap: unresolved robust advantage, not zero true benefit
benefit.zero_control: zero C_U undefined; zero Q_U unbounded upper; no fabricated ratios
benefit.registry_score: 81-sample legacy structural score remains a separate secondary diagnostic, not retrospectively revised

confirmation: reserved E/F starts must not be rotation/translation equivalents of any development, prior protocol009, or new calibration start; equivalence blocked before acquisition
previous_observation: A age0 and B age100 reproduce previously measured preparations; flag all exact effective aliases and never call them independent or heldout

execution.schedule: acquisition, independent audit, rendering and Git packing sequentially
execution.resume: hash-bound completed cases; all interruptions retained

acquisition: design freeze only in this step; runner/readiness validation and benchmark required before main acquisition

controls.original_phase_controls: all30 saved protocol009 complete phase patches, require original identity
controls.known_omitted_inputs: three distinct protocol010 unknown-source complete inputs, require any stable identity
controls.scope: repeated implementation/assay controls, never new independent samples
